subject: physical-education
essentialQuestion: How can understanding dance, rhythm, and creative performance help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?

prompts.prompt: Explain movement quality in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of complex rhythmic patterns.
Apply choreographic devices in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving partner and group safety; correct it and explain why.
Connect movement quality with performance and critique. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Create, learn, or analyze a movement work with accessible performance and attribution options.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

adaptationChoices: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.
